variants.headline: Still in view: colony openly defies its charter
variants.sub: Open defiance of the charter is taking place in {colony}.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. The colony is openly defying its charter.

The position of {target} warrants scrutiny through the reported defiance. This account does not presume the precise breach or announce a punitive consequence that has not been established in the report.
